question: When is it released?

answer.answer_value: Additional performance security refunded on satisfactory completion of work; performance security lapses 3 months after the defect liability period

answer.notes: No separate release clause for the main performance security. It simply expires on its validity date.

question: Are there extra guarantee requirements (additional performance security for low bids)?

answer.answer_value: Additional performance security if the bid is more than 15% below the estimate: contract amount times the difference between the bid percentage below and 15%; valid to stipulated completion plus 3 months
answer.verbatim_quote: Additional Performance Security, if any Equal to an amount arrived at, by multiplying the contract amount with difference of percentage between percent rates (below/minus) of successful bid and 15% percent (below/minus), considering bid rates less than Fifteen percent
